operationalization.fully_addressed: Either (a) a stated, reproducible survey (search terms, databases, date, inclusion rule) of published multidimensional BC metric comparisons, tabulating per study how epsilon was set per metric and whether initial or realised coverage was reported, with prevalence wording in abstract/sec.1/sec.3 matching what it found; or (b) an explicit sentence framing the note as a pre-emptive guideline (e.g. 'we do not claim this practice is common; the protocol is offered pre-emptively').
